name: eng-workspace-governance
summary: Owns reproducible multi-repository workspace topology, exact refs, dependency order, and handoff context.
input_contract: For topology changes, participating repository identities and dependency facts; for reproducible handoff or verification, exact consumed commits and required launch context.
output_contract: Actual topology/dependency decision or reproducible handoff; optional version 2 workspace slice with manifest reference, exact repository tuple, and dependency edges.
